contact.name: Contact
contact.text: You must be touching what you act on.

sight.name: Sight
sight.text: You must be able to see what you act on.

stillness.name: Stillness
stillness.text: You must be standing still when you act.

held_breath.name: Held Breath
held_breath.text: It works only for as long as you hold your breath.

spoken.name: Spoken Aloud
spoken.text: You must say aloud what you intend. Anyone near hears it.

near_water.name: Near Water
near_water.text: It answers only within reach of open water.

named.name: Named
named.text: You must know what the thing you act on truly is.

night.name: Night
night.text: It sleeps while the sun is up.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.text: Every use takes it out of your body like a sprint.

heat.name: Heat
heat.text: Your blood runs hot afterwards, enough to blister.

conservation.name: Conservation
conservation.text: What you move must go somewhere. Some of it comes back to you.

memory.name: Memory
memory.text: Each use takes something you remember. You do not choose what.

debt.name: Debt
debt.text: The body pays later, with interest, in hunger and sleep.

mark.name: The Mark
mark.text: A pattern spreads across your skin with every use. People notice.

pain.name: Pain
pain.text: It hurts. It always hurts the same amount.

silence.name: Silence
silence.text: Afterwards you cannot speak for hours.

expressions: a sound like a struck bell, heard only by you
your shadow falling a moment behind you
the smell of rain before a storm
pale script crawling across your forearms
your eyes catching light that is not there
a low hum in the ground beneath your feet
salt crystals forming in the lines of your hands
your breath steaming even in summer
a second heartbeat, slower than your own
every candle near you leaning towards you
a taste of iron and old coins
